tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder Should rate quote including GST

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have supplied same or similar category goods in at least one of last five years to any central/state Govt Organization/PSU/ Urban Local bodies/ Public listed company. Copies of relevant work certificates from competent authority should be uploaded. (Issued by the officer not below the rank of tender inviting authority)

Firm Name, Proprietor/Managing Director Name, Full Address and Official Mobile Number to be uploaded & (In case of Registered Partnership Firm, attested copies of partnership deed and power of attorney & Authorization to sign legal documents of tender and to submit the bid in KPPP e-Portal should be uploaded by the bidder along with the tender) In case of a company, Articles of Association, Memorandum of Association besides Resolution of BOD authorizing the Signatory to sign the bid should be uploaded).
The firm/dealer must upload a valid CDSCO license issued by the Competent Authority of CDSCO. (Central Drugs Standard Control Organization)
Bidder should upload self-declaration stating that the firm is not Blacklisted on a Rs 100 stamp paper.
